// CASE swift_member_recv expect=fire
func a(items: [Int], step: (Int) async -> Int, getCache: () async -> Cache) async {
  for item in items {
    (await getCache()).value = await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_subscript_recv expect=fire
func b(items: [Int], step: (Int) async -> Int, getCache: () async -> Cache) async {
  for item in items {
    (await getCache())[item] = await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_tuple_recv expect=fire
func c(items: [Int], step: (Int) async -> (Int, Int), getCache: () async -> Cache) async {
  for item in items {
    ((await getCache()).value, other) = await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_lazy_plus_recv expect=fire
func d(
  items: [Int], step: (Int) async -> Int, read: (Int) async -> Row, getCache: () async -> Cache
) async {
  var saved: Row? = nil
  for item in items {
    if saved == nil { saved = await read(item) }
    (await getCache()).value = await step(item)
  }
}
